interface.name: pw_frame_manager_v1

description.summary: Correlate an app frame with a base-authorized grant

interface.description: This request grants no authority and produces no presentation evidence. Tag and wp_presentation.feedback MUST precede the same wl_surface.commit that submits the rendered buffer. The base shell consumes the tag once. A grant is delivered separately by the base controller, never minted here. A frame tag is an opaque bounded token mapped by the applying owner to its exact configuration or trial/sequence/hash. The shell does not interpret geometry or assert that the renderer implemented its claimed transform.

event.name: grant

description.summary: Base-issued surface grant, never Runtime authority

event.description: State 0 is candidate/synthetic-only, 1 is admitted, 2 is revoked, 3 is an explicitly authorized pending same-process revision. The active admitted grant remains valid until the pending revision is presented. Each new grant UUID fences prior process/Output/configuration state.

request.name: overlay

description.summary: Primitives for the same tagged buffer

request.description: Exactly four normalized output corner points, bounded JSON. Consumed with the next surface commit. Only matching authorized trial/hash presentation can publish these primitives to the private diagnostic client.

event.name: grant_frame

description.summary: Exact Frame identity, including equal-counter rebinds

event.description: Replaces grant for version 3 clients. Frame identity is mandatory authority scope; two Frames may legitimately have equal generation and revision.

event.name: picture
event.description: Bounded canonical JSON of contracts.node_frame.PictureOperations, at most 1024 bytes (picture operations v5, the print look; 512 before), sent by the base controller through the shell for one Output. The shell forwards it verbatim and never interprets it. It is re-sent to a client that binds later and after a Weston restart. The app applies the newest one it received for the Output in its final pass.

request.name: tag_picture

description.summary: Tag a buffer with its frame tag and its picture change

request.description: Replaces tag for version 4 clients, with the same rules. picture_change is the decimal picture change of the operations this buffer was drawn with, or "0" before any picture event (contracts.node_frame.picture_change_text). The shell echoes it in its presented event; it grants nothing.

interface.name: pw_diagnostic_manager_v1
interface.description: Only the compositor-created private diagnostic client may bind this global. Output events name physical Output pixels. Serial is acknowledged before committing the corresponding page buffer. No application can obtain this role.

request.name: get_health_layer

description.summary: Give a surface the Output's health layer role

request.description: The health layer stacks above every other shell layer, app and slate alike. A buffer maps the surface; a NULL buffer unmaps it. One per Output.

event.name: brightness

description.summary: The base page's brightness line for one Output (roadmap 1c)

event.description: Display text composed by the base controller (where brightness acts and its value), forwarded verbatim by the shell; at most 128 bytes. Re-sent when the diagnostic client binds. The client draws it on the base page.

event.name: region

description.summary: The Output's Frame region for the debug overlay (issue #124)

event.description: Canonical JSON of contracts.node_output.FrameRegion, at most 1024 bytes, or empty: none. Forwarded verbatim; the shell never interprets geometry. Sent by the base controller through the shell, re-sent when the diagnostic client binds and right after every output event, so a configure is always followed by its region. The client draws the slate and the health card inside the region when it can be met, on the whole Output otherwise.
